**Director & Shareholder:** The company has **2 directors** and **2 shareholders**. The largest shareholder is **Director 1** with **51.02 %** of the equity.  

**Financials:** For the latest FY 2024, revenue reached **RM5.6m**, up **36.7 %** from FY 2023. Gross profit margin was **54.2 %** and operating profit margin **11.7 %**. Free cash flow was **RM357.8k** and net debt (borrowings less cash) stood at **RM1.9m**, indicating positive cash generation despite elevated leverage.  

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.  

**Review Rating:** **4/5 – High review priority**. The firm shows strong revenue growth, healthy margins and positive free cash flow, with no defendant litigation, though its net debt remains material.
